description: Search real-time Airbnb & boutique short-term stays in any city or region with nightly rates, total trip pricing, Superhost badges, star ratings, review counts, GPS coordinates, and high-res interior photography. Cost: 5 Credits / stay returned (0 Credits if empty).

checkin.description: Optional check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to +30 days if omitted).

checkout.description: Optional check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to +33 days if omitted).

location.description: City, neighborhood, or destination name, e.g. "Paris", "Kyoto", or "Joshua Tree, CA".

name: stays_search

data.description: Live short-term stay search results with pricing and interior photos.

stays.description: Normalized short-term stay listings with nightly price, ratings, Superhost flag, coordinates, and photos.

meta.description: Request telemetry, credit billing, and cache status metadata.

cached.description: Whether the response was served from warm cache.

credits_charged.description: Credits deducted for this call (0 on cache-empty or error).

took_ms.description: End-to-end server processing latency in milliseconds.

title: Search Short-Term Boutique Stays, Nightly Rates & Interior Photos
